projects.title: ControllerPlayground
projects.summary: A controller-first Windows gaming shell, built for the couch, with C#, WinUI 3 and a native C++ input layer.
highlights: Native C++ DLL over Microsoft GameInput with a fixed-layout, versioned ABI consumed from C#
Multiple Xbox and DualSense controllers with per-device identity and modal ownership
On-screen keyboard runs as a separate process over an authenticated, versioned pipe protocol
Steam sign-in by QR code, friends and chat via SteamKit2, plus local Steam data parsing

projects.title: E-Commerce Web App
projects.summary: Full shopping flow from browsing to payment: product catalog, persistent carts, checkout with Stripe, and order history.
highlights: Stripe Payment Intents with server-side cart totals
Session auth with Passport: local, Google and Facebook OAuth
React Router pages with Context and Redux Toolkit state

projects.title: E-Commerce REST API
projects.summary: REST API for users, products, carts, checkout and orders, with layered routes, controllers and models.
highlights: Password hashing with bcrypt and JWT support

projects.title: Jammming
projects.summary: Search Spotify, build a playlist in the browser, and save it straight to your Spotify account.
highlights: Spotify Web API integration isolated in its own service module
Tests for API behavior and UI interactions

projects.title: Reddit Client
projects.summary: Browse subreddits, posts and comments through Reddit's public JSON endpoints.
highlights: Async data loading with Redux Toolkit
Skeleton loading and explicit error states

projects.title: Python CPU Simulator
projects.summary: A small CPU simulation with registers, a program counter, a memory bus and a toggleable cache layer.
highlights: Parses and executes ADD, ADDI, J and CACHE instructions from a file
Processor, memory and cache split into separate modules

projects.title: Restaurant Recommender
projects.summary: A command-line restaurant recommender built on a hand-written linked list.

projects.title: Profiles in C++
projects.summary: A small matchmaking-profile exercise in C++ classes with separate headers and a CMake build.
